english.title: Obstruct / impede an authorised person in execution of duty on Transport for London road transport premises
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) whilst on Transport for London road transport premises at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), wilfully obstructed or impeded an authorised person in the execution of

(A)_[his]_
(B)_[her]_

duty
english.legislation: Contrary to byelaws 9(3) and 14 of the Transport for London Road Transport Premises Byelaws made under paragraph 26 of Schedule 11 to the Greater London Authority Act 1999 and confirmed under section 67 of the Transport Act 1962.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
whilst on Transport for London Road Transport Premises
wilfully obstructed/impeded an authorised person in the execution of his/her duty

investigatoraction.description: Guilty Plea by letter procedure may be offered for this offence
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) See Byelaw 13 for the provision of a name and address by persons suspected of breaching this byelaw.
(ii) See byelaw 15 for a power to remove persons breaching this byelaw
(iii) See byelaw 16 for the requirement for authorised persons exercising any power conferred any of the Byelaws to produce a form of identification when requested to do so.
(iv) See Byelaw 17 in relation to the provision of notices.
english.standardstatementoffacts:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) the defendant, whilst on Transport for London road transport premises at **(..SPECIFY THE LOCATION..), wilfully obstructed or impeded an authorised person in the execution of

(A)_[his]_
(B)_[her]_

duty.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale.

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
